text:
Ivy (PM): Short design review: prompt-sets Run UI. Goals: keep scorecard visible for long diffs, make bulk selection discoverable by keyboard, and tighten approval copy.

Carlos (Designer): Shared prototype. Idea: floating compact scorecard that sticks to the top-right when scrolling, plus a persistent left filter rail. Diff rows are density-aware with chevrons to expand.

Mina (Frontend): Floating scorecard ok but needs careful stacking context. Suggest making it position:sticky with small offset, fall back to inline for very narrow viewports. For the list, virtualize and persist expanded ids in Redux to avoid losing state.

Jared (Eng): Backend must support bulk approve with undo_token + undo_window_ms. Undo performs a reverse operation via a background job; make operations idempotent. Also return an optimistic_update_id for frontend reconciliation.

Sofia (A11y): Accessibility notes: 1) The floating scorecard must be reachable via keyboard and announced appropriately; add a skip link to jump to results. 2) Provide visible focus styles for chevrons and info icons. 3) Approve buttons need explicit accessible names like 'Approve evaluation <id>'. 4) Color contrast for faded chips must meet 4.5:1.

Nadia (ProdEng): Analytics events requested: 'scorecard_stuck','filter_focused','diff_expanded','range_select_started','bulk_approve_confirmed','undo_triggered'. Include run_id, user_id, selected_count.

Carlos (Designer): Copy for bulk confirm: 'Approve 6 evaluations — marked accepted for Run #762. Undo available for 5 minutes.' Added a small inline link 'How undo works' to modal.

Ivy (PM): Decisions: 1) Floating compact scorecard (sticky) with keyboard skip link; 2) Persistent left filter rail; 3) Virtualized list + store expanded ids; 4) Keyboard range-select (Shift+Arrow) + 'a' select-all; 5) Inline confirm for single-item, modal for bulk with copy above; 6) A11y fixes per Sofia; 7) Analytics events to Nadia; 8) Backend undo/idempotency to Jared.

Mina (Frontend): I'll prototype the sticky scorecard and keyboard shortcuts in a branch. Will add focus trap only for full-screen modals.

Jared (Eng): I'll open tickets for undo pipeline and optimistic updates.

Sofia (A11y): I'll draft a quick checklist and test script for screen readers and keyboard-only flows.

Carlos (Designer): Updating prototype with sticky scorecard and tooltip-accessible legend. Will post new Loom.

Ivy (PM): Thanks all — target sign-off at Monday's design review. :thumbsup:
